description:
Janet Carroll Estate Agents are delighted to present Apartment 212, Beechwood Court to the market. Situated on the sixth floor, this superb two-bedroom apartment extends to approximately 71ms (764 sq.ft.) and is presented in excellent turnkey condition. Flooded with natural light, the apartment enjoys a spacious west-facing balcony offering spectacular panoramic views stretching from the Dublin Mountains across the city skyline, taking in Pigeon House, Howth Head and Dublin Bay.
Constructed in 2006 by Jackson Homes Ltd., Beechwood Court is a highly regarded and meticulously maintained residential development. Residents benefit from beautifully landscaped communal gardens, an on-site crèche and a welcoming community atmosphere. Ideally positioned just off the N11, this sought-after location offers exceptional convenience, with easy access to nearby villages, excellent schools and outstanding transport links. The property is certain to appeal to a broad range of purchasers, including first-time buyers, investors and those looking to downsize without compromising on quality or location.
The apartment also benefits from a designated underground parking space, with two separate vehicle access points providing added convenience and ease of access.
The location is second to none. Situated just off the Stillorgan Road, residents enjoy an excellent selection of amenities nearby, including the shopping centres and villages of Foxrock, Stillorgan and Blackrock, renowned for their boutiques, cafés, restaurants and vibrant atmosphere. Blackrock Clinic, Beacon Hospital and St. Vincent’s University Hospital are all within easy reach, while excellent public transport connections and major road networks make commuting effortless.

Viewing is strongly advised.

OUTSIDE

There is one parking space allocated to this apartment. There are several visitor parking spaces above ground, as well as unmarked communal spaces in the underground car park. The common areas are well kept with manicured landscaping throughout.
